verdict.rationale: Capsule's own homepage claims "100+ integrations", and its features page names prebuilt Gmail, Outlook and Data Studio connections, so prebuilt integrations exist. However, nothing shows an installable app marketplace or the specific categories in the story. Zapier is a third-party connector and earns no credit here. Missing for 10: a documented app marketplace or install flow; Slack, support-desk, marketing and data-warehouse integrations; integration docs; independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can install prebuilt integrations (Slack, support desk, marketing, data warehouse) from an app marketplace

citations.quote: Access Capsule directly from Gmail. Add contacts, conversations, tasks and sales opportunities.
Easily manage contacts, conversations & sales opportunities from within your Outlook inbox.
